title: F1 score: balancing precision and recall

steps.label: Judge by precision only
steps.python:
a, b = 0.95, 0.75
print('higher precision:', 'A' if a > b else 'B')
# prints: higher precision: A

steps.label: Judge by recall only
steps.python:
a, b = 0.40, 0.75
print('higher recall:', 'A' if a > b else 'B')
# prints: higher recall: B

steps.label: Model A: precision 0.95, recall 0.40
steps.pseudocode: Model A is precise but misses most positives.
steps.python:
p, r = 0.95, 0.40
print('misses', round(1 - r, 2), 'of positives')
# prints: misses 0.6 of positives

steps.label: Model B: precision 0.75, recall 0.75
steps.python:
p, r = 0.75, 0.75
print('misses', round(1 - r, 2), 'of positives')
# prints: misses 0.25 of positives
